column3: “deceitfully” renders a word read as “in Tormah” or “in treachery”; “stirring up” renders “shutting up.”
“rush upon” renders “make a raid on”; “whatever you can” renders “as your hand finds.”
“the highest part of the land” renders “the navel of the land”; “the diviners’ oak” renders “the great tree of the soothsayer.”
“it was told” renders the impersonal “people told.”
“the company” is singular for the Hebrew plural “the companies”; “dashed” renders “made a raid.”
“the inner chamber” renders a rare word for a stronghold or cellar; “temple” renders “house.”
“an axe” renders the Hebrew plural “the axes.”
“so that it will not be said” renders “lest people say.”
“the men of Israel” renders the collective “the man of Israel”; “home” renders “place.”
